_comment_file: Shipped defaults for oidc-auth-server (#15). Lowest layer of three: this file, then the host's app-custom-config.json, then the environment for keys listed in oidc-auth-server.config.env-keys. Maps merge per entry; every other value is replaced whole. Settings only: secrets never live in a config file, and callbacks (findAccount, interactionUrl, adapter) are code options passed to createAuthServer.
_comment_issuer: The issuer identifier: https, no query or fragment, including the mount path if any. The host sets it in app-custom-config.json; the empty value here refuses the boot until it is set.
_comment_development: Allows an http issuer and the in-memory adapter. Never true in production.
_comment_acr_values: The acr values the host's sign-in can produce, advertised in discovery. Empty means the host reports none.
_comment_scope_claims: Claims released per scope, beyond openid (which always carries sub, acr, amr and auth_time). Defaults are OIDC Core 5.4 profile and email. A map: a host adds a scope without restating these.
_comment_clients: Statically registered clients, as node-oidc-provider client metadata.
_comment_ttl: Lifetimes in seconds. Session matches ngdpbase's 24-hour session max-age. Grant and refresh token bound how long a client keeps access without the person signing in again.
_comment_secret_keys: Keys never displayed by a host's configuration screen. Both are environment-only.
_comment_env_keys: Keys owned by the environment, and the variable that supplies each. A key listed here is read only from its variable: setting it in a config file refuses the boot, so a secret cannot end up in one. jwks is a JSON Web Key Set as JSON; cookie-keys is comma-separated.
